idea-plugin.name: MCP Server Extension
idea-plugin.description:
Extends the JetBrains MCP Server in Rider with the IDE surfaces the built-in tools do not cover. Everything is prefixed with rider_; build, debugger, terminal, refactorings and search stay with the built-in tools, and the tool descriptions point agents to them.

  • Test runner: scoped runs by filter/class/method, structured results with stack traces, rerun failed
  • Database consoles: open consoles and table tabs, scripts with GO batches, background jobs with PRINT/RAISERROR progress, read-only guard, secret masking, CSV/JSON export, results of user-run scripts
  • Tool windows: any panel as text (Run, Debug app console, Build, Problems, TODO, Endpoints, Services)
  • IDE state and context: indexing/busy, cursor, selection, open editors, unsaved files, bookmarks
  • Run configurations: create, clone with args/env, update, delete
  • NuGet, Publish, workspace configuration: add/remove/restore packages, Publish output and RID/publishDir
  • Solution Wide Analysis error counts, inspection settings, IDE-managed processes, live dotTrace/dotMemory sessions, cache invalidation

Requires Rider 2026.2+. On Rider 2026.1 the Marketplace installs the 1.2.x line.
